role: Index of ADRs 001-006 with inline summaries of 001 (encryption fallback), 002 (CI scopes: unit on every pull request and push, full on demand), 003 (concurrency allowlist) and pointers to 004-006.

units.does: Index table mapping ADR 001-006 to where reasoning lives (PendingEncryptionLedger.swift, CI_POSTURE.md, check_unchecked_sendable.sh, adr files); says the first three are written up next to the code they govern. All linked files exist.

units.key: § Architecture decision records > 001 — Sensitive storage falls back, then repairs
units.does: Claims: when EncryptionManager is unavailable (before first unlock), archive writes plaintext with .completeFileProtection, records the session in PendingEncryptionLedger, and reencryptPendingSessions() rewrites it encrypted at the next launch where the key is reachable; the window is 'bounded by one app launch'; only a throwing encrypt() is logged at .error, while the key-unavailable fallback is not logged and shows only as the ledger entry. Verified the write options (Archive+PendingEncryption.swift:18-30), encryptOrReportFailure (Archive+SessionCodec.swift:113-126: isAvailable guard returns nil silently, catch logs .error), and the launch-time repair called from ArchiveMigrations.runDeferredMigrations.

units.key: § Architecture decision records > 002 — The macOS jobs run at scope `unit`; the full run is on demand
units.does: Claims the no-Xcode script gates run on a Linux runner on every pull request and push to main (gates.yml), the macOS jobs in ci.yml (SwiftLint and budgets, strict concurrency, build, unit suite, Thread Sanitizer) run at scope unit on every pull request and push to main, and the UI target and full coverage floors (scope full) run on demand and before every release; points to CI_POSTURE.md for per-scope cost. Verified: gates.yml and ci.yml trigger on pull_request, push to main and workflow_dispatch; ci.yml's tests job takes scope unit when inputs.scope is empty; workflow_call defaults to full (testflight.yml).

units.key: § Architecture decision records > 003 — Concurrency escapes are allowlisted, not eliminated
units.does: Claims remaining @unchecked Sendable / nonisolated(unsafe) annotations are in allowlisted files, count read from .ci/unchecked_sendable_budget.txt (14), enforced by check_unchecked_sendable.sh. Verified: 14 allowlisted files, 14 non-comment annotations.

units.key: § Architecture decision records > 004 — Debt is ratcheted, never waived
§ Architecture decision records > 005 — Helpers hold their owner strongly; `unowned` is banned
units.does: Summary of ADR 005: an unowned back-pointer from a helper traps when a resumed continuation outlives the owner; helpers are values holding the owner strongly, built on demand, and a gate bans unowned. Consistent with 005-no-unowned-back-references.md.
